threshold_basis.data_integrity: Hard data checks; any failure means the inputs are not the documented dataset.
threshold_basis.prior_predictive_coverage: Rules out priors that cannot generate the observed data. A weak check: the prior predictive interval is wide by design, so a PASS says little about prior quality.
threshold_basis.convergence: ESS >= 400 bulk and tail follows Vehtari et al. (2021). R-hat <= 1.05 is looser than their 1.01 and stricter than Meridian's own health check (R-hat < 1.2). Up to 0.5% divergent draws (20 of 4000) are tolerated.
threshold_basis.negative_baseline: A negative baseline means media and the other drivers are credited with more than all of the revenue, which is impossible. Meridian flags a model for review above 0.2 and fails it above 0.8; we fail at its review level.
threshold_basis.insample_r2: Geo-week: revenue scales with population, so geo levels dominate the variance; a model must explain at least half of it. National: weekly revenue has CV 6.9% and is close to white noise (lag-1 -0.02), so there is little variance to explain and a modest R2 is the realistic bar.
threshold_basis.insample_coverage: Nominal 94%; 85-99% allows for sampling noise. Below: intervals too narrow; above: too wide.
threshold_basis.within_geo_r2: Geo-week revenue has a within-geo CV of 30% and is close to white noise, so most within-geo variance is unexplainable; this flags a model with almost no within-geo signal.
threshold_basis.residual_autocorrelation: Revenue itself has lag-1 autocorrelation near 0 (EDA), so residual autocorrelation signals missing time structure.
threshold_basis.cv: National MAPE: a 13-week moving average has MAPE 5.1% nationally, so 10% is about 1.9x the noise floor; kept at the study-brief value. The error ratio and coverage are relative measures and need no noise-floor adjustment. Geo-week MAPE is not gated directly: its noise floor is 23%.
threshold_basis.roi_fold_stability: ROI that changes several-fold when a quarter of data is added is not a stable estimate.
threshold_basis.channel_roi_checks: Contraction below 0.30 means the posterior keeps more than 70% of the prior spread, so the data say little. A payback call needs at least 90% posterior probability either way.
